Databricks: The Lakehouse for Intelligent Finance
#Banking is a data business trapped in silos - core systems on mainframes, risk on grids, fraud on streaming platforms, and reporting in stale warehouses.
#Databricks solves this with the lakehouse, combining #data lake scale with warehouse governance on Delta Lake - one open, ACID-compliant copy for batch and streaming.
For banks, this unlocks three use cases:
1. Risk & Compliance: Market and exposure data streams into Delta in near real-time. VaR and CCAR stress tests that took 12 hours now run in under an hour. Unity Catalog provides full lineage and audit for BCBS 239 and RBI reporting, with time-travel for reproducibility.
2. Real-Time Fraud: Transactions stream via Structured Streaming, features are served from a unified Feature Store, and MLflow models score in <100ms. Graph analytics uncovers money laundering networks that rules miss.
3. Customer 360 & Personalization: Clickstream, mobile, and product data unify into a single customer view. Teams use Databricks SQL for insights and Mosaic AI for next-best-action and GenAI assistants.
The result is 60% lower costs, fresher data, and a shift from reporting to AI-driven decisions - from loan approvals in minutes to autonomous risk management.
